key_insight: C-ReD builds a diverse, real-world Chinese benchmark that significantly improves evaluation of AI-generated text detectors by using authentic prompts and outputs from multiple LLMs.
problem_solved: Addresses lack of diversity and real-world representativeness in existing Chinese corpora for AI-generated text detection, which limited detector robustness and cross-model generalization.
method: Collect large-scale real-world prompts paired with human-written responses and outputs from multiple Chinese-capable LLMs to create a mixed dataset.
Standardize labeling and metadata (model source, prompt type, topic, length) to enable targeted evaluation and slicing.
Benchmark a range of detection methods across dataset slices to reveal strengths and failure modes (cross-model, prompt-type, length).
impact: Provides practitioners with a more realistic testbed to develop and stress-test detectors for Chinese text, enabling better generalization and deployment-safe models. It helps reveal where detectors fail and guides model-agnostic improvements.
visual_elements: Pipeline diagram: real-world prompt collection → multi-LLM generation → human data → labeled benchmark

paper_title: C-ReD: A Comprehensive Chinese Benchmark for AI-Generated Text Detection Derived from Real-World Prompts
paper_authors: Chenxi Qing, Junxi Wu, Zheng Liu, Yixiang Qiu, Hongyao Yu
